Body.Content:
Microsoft Azure IP Advantage is now available. It provides comprehensive protection against intellectual property (IP) risks with uncapped indemnification and access to a portfolio of thousands of Microsoft patents. With Azure IP Advantage, developers can focus on writing code without worrying about companies that sue developers, and customers can grow their business with confidence. 

To learn more about this program, please visit the Microsoft Azure IP Advantage page.
